field_docs.mission: time_limit_seconds: evac countdown in seconds (the --mission-time=SECONDS launch argument overrides it); starts when the squads deploy. evac_call_seconds: seconds left after the player calls the evac, if more remain at that moment (not above time_limit_seconds)
field_docs.evac: position: [x, z] metres of the evac zone centre; radius: metres; color: RGBA 0..1 of the flat disc. Units standing inside are extracted when the timer ends, or at once when all living soldiers are inside
field_docs.carry: slowdown: speed lost at a load equal to the soldier's carry_capacity (soldier_classes.json), e.g. 0.6 = 60% slower; min_speed_multiplier: lowest speed fraction 0..1 however heavy the load. Speed multiplier = max(min_speed_multiplier, 1 - slowdown * carried_weight / carry_capacity)
field_docs.loot: loot_time: seconds a soldier stands at a cache to loot it; loot_range: metres from the cache centre at which looting works
field_docs.caches: Supply caches: position [x, z] metres (beside a building so it is reachable); weight: carried weight added to the looter; value: loot value counted when extracted
field_docs.civilians: count: how many civilians (0 to the number of shelters); hit_points: bite damage before dying; walk_speed: metres per second; follow_distance: metres they keep from the nearest soldier of their squad; repath_interval: seconds between path updates; color: body RGB 0..1; unassigned_color: ring RGB 0..1 while they have no squad; marker_color: RGB 0..1 of the shelter marker shown on an explored building; discover_range: metres from the shelter position at which a soldier finds the civilian; shelters: one per civilian, position [x, z] inside a building and door [x, z] beside it where the civilian appears (snapped to the navigation mesh). Civilians start healthy and unassigned; the player assigns them
